  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MARCH 6, 2018

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Pro Tem Davis at 4:32
p.m., on Tuesday, March 6, 2018, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Ted Winterer (arrived at 4:40p.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Tony Vazquez

  Absent:  Councilmember Pam O’Connor

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE  On order of the Mayor Pro Tem, the City Council convened at 4:32 p.m.,
  with all members present except Councilmember O’Connor and Mayor
  Winterer.

CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.

Mayor Winterer arrived at  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:33 p.m., to consider
4:30 p.m.  closed sessions and returned at 5:36 p.m., with Councilmember O’Connor
  absent, to report the following:

  1.A.  Public Employee Evaluation
  Title: City Clerk

  The Mayor reported this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:36 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Ted Winterer
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  March 6, 2018
